publishing.description:
The export arrives with stray spaces, numbers stored as text and junk rows at the top. You fix it by hand. Next month's export has the same problems, and you fix it again.

Excel Power Query for Absolute Beginners shows you how to fix it once. Power Query records every cleaning step you take and repeats them each time you refresh. Instead of long chapters, you get 77 short lessons, one idea per page, each with a clear diagram of what is happening and one small thing to try before you move on.

Inside, you'll learn how to:
- Start a query from a table, and read the Power Query Editor and its Applied Steps
- Bring data in from other workbooks, text files and whole folders
- Set the kind of data right, so dates sort and numbers add up
- Clean what arrives: headers, junk rows, stray spaces, capital letters and duplicates
- Filter, sort and find errors
- Split and merge columns, add calculated columns, and unpivot a report built for people
- Stack tables and join them, including looking up a value
- Refresh a query, and fix it when a heading is renamed or a file moves
- Feed a clean query into a PivotTable

It helps if you can already type data into Excel and use SUM. No unexplained jargon.

By the last page, your data won't just be clean. It will stay clean, every refresh.
publishing.audience: Excel users who clean the same untidy export by hand every week or month.
